name: Boarding pass
oneLiner: a real card-stock boarding pass slides across a stone counter on twos, the route line draws from where you are to where you are going, a brand-colour rubber stamp thumps on, and the stub tears off along its punched perforation
say: when the speaker names a move from one state to another ('from idea to launch', 'this is where we are going next'): the route draws as they say it and the stamp lands on the commitment
